Computes starvation mortality rate \[\mu_s(w) = \frac{-E_r(w)}{w} \times \texttt{starv\_coef}\] size classes energy balance negative (\(E_r < 0\)). code: params <- setStarvation(params, starv_coef = 10) starvMort <- function(params, n, n_pp, n_other, t = 0, ...) {     e <- getEReproAndGrowth(params, n = n, n_pp = n_pp, n_other = n_other,                             t = t)     starv_coef <- species_params(params)[["starv_coef"]]     mu_s <- -t(t(e * starv_coef) / params@w)     mu_s[e > 0] <- 0     mu_s }
